title: An Interdisciplinary Review of Commonsense Reasoning and Intent Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing studies (e.g., using the GD-VCR dataset) that evaluate visual reasoning models on geo-diverse imagery to measure performance disparities between Western scenes and scenes from Africa and Asia.
Reviewing studies that analyze multilingual commonsense reasoning datasets (e.g., X-CSQA, Mickey Corpus) to identify English-centric biases and Western logic preserved in translated queries.
